decision.hypothesis: Dimension A says 76 (credited for a weak map pack); organic-v1.1 says 18 — the organic top-5 is real roofers explicitly targeting Rochester. The single cleanest test of which rankability model predicts reality.
decision.successCondition: Reaches top-10 within 6 months => organic-v1.1 wrongly discounts map-pack evidence and Dimension A should stand.
decision.failureCondition: Never reaches top-20 => A's map-pack credit is confirmed spurious and A must be rebuilt around organic structure as A-2.0.0.
